trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about grandfathering previous customers into new features and limits.

trials.claim: Store can be built and scaled with 1500+ native features without plugins or coding
trials.claimQuote: Build, manage, and scale your online store with 1,500+ native features—no plugins or coding required
trials.reasoning: Reviews report there is no native product bundle feature and no local city or ZIP-level sales tax calculation, materially limiting the claim of complete native features for building and scaling without plugins or coding.

exhibits.quote: There is no native product bundle feature to combine multiple items into a single kit with individual product inventory tracking.
exhibits.argument: Quote reports a core ecommerce capability is missing natively, undermining the claim of complete native features without plugins.

exhibits.quote: They don't support sales tax calculations on a local level (City or zip code) only as far as the State level and that won't work for some States, including California.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows native tax features are incomplete for US sellers, undermining the scale without coding claim.

exhibits.quote: - Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms many core commerce capabilities are native with no add-ons or plugins required.

exhibits.quote: If you're looking for an ecommerce platform that doesn't require you to be a tech expert, I'd definitely recommend giving Selldone a try, particularly with the awesome Set Up service they offer.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms a non-technical user can build a store without needing coding expertise.

trials.claim: Launch on custom domain includes cloud hosting, SSL and CDN
trials.claimQuote: Launch on your own custom domain with cloud hosting, SSL certification, and CDN (content delivery network) included
trials.reasoning: A reviewer confirms building a store with a custom domain with SSL on the platform. The prosecution exhibit only shows support helped resolve a domain/SSL issue via Cloudflare, not that SSL was not included.

exhibits.quote: When I ran into a domain/SSL issue, he responded incredibly fast in the support chat and pointed me in exactly the right direction (Cloudflare integration) to get it sorted.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows SSL on custom domain required external Cloudflare integration work, undermining that SSL is included.

exhibits.quote: After actually building things out, products, categories, discount codes, custom domain with SSL, page builder, product variants and SKUs I've been really impressed by how much this platform can do!
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms they built out a store using custom domain with SSL on the platform.

trials.claim: Includes built-in CMS and blog for content management
trials.claimQuote: Publish and manage content natively with a built-in CMS (content management system) and blog
trials.reasoning: A reviewer explicitly lists CMS plus blog among the platform's native features with no add-ons or plugins, directly supporting the claim.

exhibits.quote: - Marketplace builder, POS, CMS + blog, subscriptions, digital file delivery, affiliates and discounts — all native. No add-ons, no plugins.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms CMS plus blog functionality is included natively in the platform.
